title: VanMor
description: About VanMor VanMor Properties, Inc. has been providing quality property management services since 1996, focusing on tailored management solutions for communities. Their offerings include financial oversight, operational support, architectural control services, and vendor management, all designed to meet the unique needs of homeowner associations. Company VanMor Properties fell victim to a cyberattack, resulting in the theft of more than 330 GB of confidential data. The stolen data includes documents containing correspondence with clients, financial information, personal data of employees and clients, as well as other important information about the company.
